messages:
Priya: Heads up — planning to deprecate the unpinned default model starting 2026-05-01 (3-week notice). need to lock runtime behavior, webhook payload, and rollback owner before we post.

Chen: quick Q: do we mean HTTP 410 for requests that rely on default when no Accept-Model provided, or keep 200 with migration hint?

Priya: prefer 410 after grace. during grace window 200 + warning header.

Luis: proposal: free-tier grace=14d, paid/dedicated=30d. During grace: 200 + headers `X-Compat-Warning: unpinned-default-deprecated` and `X-Grace-End: 2026-05-15T00:00:00Z`. If client sends `Accept-Model: <model>` we honor it. After grace: 410 with body: 
```json
{"error":"model_unpinned_deprecated","migration":"https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate-pin","suggested_model":"redwood/gpt-instruct-1"}
```

Dana: nit — maybe 409 vs 410? 410 signals gone which is fine. We should include `Retry-After` for scheduled rollover if we plan immediate switch?

Chen: +1 on Retry-After. also add machine-readable `Warning` header?

Priya: concrete header set: `X-Compat-Warning`, `X-Grace-End`, optional `Retry-After` when cutoff immediate.

ops-bot: scheduled-deprecation created by @Priya for redwood/default-v1 on 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z

Luis: webhooks — Rachel (cc) to own? we need event types: `deprecation.upcoming` (T-14), `deprecation.reminder` (T-3), `deprecation.final` (cutoff). payload fields: event, model, deprecated_at, grace_end, docs_url, affected_customers_count.

Rachel: I can own webhooks. payload example: 
```json
{"event":"deprecation.upcoming","model":"redwood/default-v1","deprecated_at":"2026-05-01T00:00:00Z","grace_end":"2026-05-31T00:00:00Z","docs":"https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate-pin"}
```

Priya: rollback/playbook — who owns? I volunteer to write rollback steps but need SRE signoff for circuit breaker.

Dana: SRE will own the rollback trigger and runbook. I'll pair with @Priya on playbook.

Chen: SDKs — we should add warnings in SDKs during grace window and auto-suggest `client.setDefaultModel(...)`. Are we shipping server-side shims or recommending client pinning?

Priya: server will accept both, but we will recommend client pinning. SDKs: patch to surface deprecation header as logger.warn. owners: @Chen for Python/Node.

Luis: docs timeline: public blog + changelog at T-21, webhook subscribers get T-14 and T-3, email to customers at T-7 for reserved accounts.

Rachel: will draft comms and update migration docs.

Priya: action items: 1) Alex (runtime) implement headers + 410 behavior by 2026-04-25, 2) Chen update SDK warnings by 2026-04-27, 3) Rachel draft webhooks + comms by 2026-04-20, 4) Dana (SRE) prepare rollback playbook by 2026-04-22.

Chen: ack. I'll create PRs and ping for reviews.

Luis: small question on metrics — let's emit `deprecation.impact` metric when we return 410. ops-bot can alert if >1% of requests 410 in a day.

ops-bot: alert rule created: deprecation_410_rate > 1% -> PagerDuty to SRE oncall

Priya: thanks all. I'll draft the announcement once runtime + webhooks are green. :thumbsup:
